research_notes: Competitive review across KLIK, Camp Snap, Flashback, Retropia, Rewindpix, Paper Shoot, and minimalist/dumbphone tech indicates three major under-leveraged audience segments in the retro/screen-free category: (1) Outdoor and backcountry wilderness campers who need to reserve smartphone battery for emergency navigation while capturing campfire memories without ruining night vision; (2) Nightlife, party, and festival attendees tired of shattered phones on wet floors, harsh phone flash, and party energy killed by poses; (3) Multi-week road trippers and gap-year travellers breaking the compulsive screen-checking habit over time. The 19 concepts balance cold top-of-funnel discovery, mid-funnel comparison/gifting logic, and bottom-of-funnel scarcity and bundle urgency while strictly adhering to verified hardware facts, Meta personal attribute compliance, and zero third-party brand or park IP.
